title: a16z Podcast: The End (and Beginning) of Programming

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There are over 20 million programmers out there -- and double that.
reader_summary.overview: There are over 20 million programmers out there -- and double that. How do we get to a billion developers? The answer. It might even mean the end of code, argues Levine (who apparently loves arguing the end of things!).
